name: Write API.md reference for library
prompt: Write API.md in this repository documenting every public function of library.py (greet, add, version): what each takes and returns. The verification script checks that API.md mentions every public function by name.
test_command: import library, pathlib; names=sorted(n for n in dir(library) if not n.startswith('_')); t=pathlib.Path('API.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); missing=[n for n in names if n not in t]; assert not missing, f'API.md missing: {missing}'
